content: The epic day has arrived, thanks to the incredibly talented team at SpaceX! This is actually a bigger deal for humanity than most people can imagine. I will always remember the looks on the engineers’ faces in the Starbase conference room in December 2020 when @elonmusk suggested, then insisted, that the Mechazilla launchpad arms could catch a returning…

Three booster catches and a ship SpaceX keeps making history. • Oct 13, 2024: First booster catch • Jan 16, 2025: Second booster catch • Mar 6, 2025: Third booster catch • Nov 14, 2026: First Starship catch
